metadata.disambiguation_note: Aikido teacher, 6th dan, founder of Aikido of Marin and author of Quantum Aikido; the Richard Moon kkron's leads are about.

facets.aikido_teacher: 6th dan; founder/chief instructor Aikido of Marin; co-founder City Aikido SF; 50+ year student of Robert Nadeau; guest teaching NZ/Europe since ~1987
facets.chef: Worked at The Source restaurant (Sunset Strip) and the Aware Inn during the Source Family era; later food work incl. Teriyaki Age product and La Cocina SF Street Food Festival
facets.executive_coach: Performance Edge consultancy with Chris Thorsen — 'Aikido and Dialogue' organizational-learning programs; Open Mind Adventures; Extraordinary Listening communications program; QuantumEdge.org — coaching for John Combs (several companies), Dan Whalen, and other QuantumEdge customers
facets.musician: moonsic.com — R. Moon 'Moon Music' (Moon Rocks, Moon Tunes); US copyright registrations list 'Richard Moon, 1946-' on San Anselmo CA music releases
facets.peace_builder: Cyprus Peace Training Team (IMTD/Fulbright consortium behind the CRTG); Bosnia Peace Trails / IMTD Lake Trails camp 1999 feeding Bosnia YLA; senior associate Nautilus Institute

metadata.context: studied tai chi, boxing, and Cheng Hsin with Ralston
metadata.note: Both sources are Moon's own self-description (primary/first-person). Not independent corroboration. Per AGENTS.md, kkron assertions are first-class graph evidence.
